time_info.description: Maximum lane-change completion window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 8 seconds, the lane-change completion event shall equal 1.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 8 秒内，变道完成事件应至少有一个时刻为 1。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 8-second window including now, the lane change shall be recorded as complete at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 8 秒窗口内，变道应至少有一个时刻被记录为完成。
